patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large, expressive serif heading offset to the left, balanced by smaller supporting text and a vintage graphic element.
Dramatic contrast between oversized, decorative serif headings (e.g., 'Multidisciplinary designer', 'build together?') and clean, understated sans-serif for body text, navigation, and small labels.
A limited, high-contrast palette featuring a warm off-white background, a deep royal blue for primary text and accents, and a bright, saturated yellow for calls to action.

The header navigation and logo remain sticky at the top of the viewport. As the user scrolls, elements within the hero section (description text, vintage TV graphic, and navigation links) scroll out of view at slightly different rates, creating a subtle layered disappearance effect before the main hero text also scrolls away.
Visual breaks are introduced by full-width image sections (e.g., the sky image with a stamp graphic) that serve as dividers between large text-based content blocks.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, implement a sticky header that fixes to the top of the viewport on scroll. For the hero section, use CSS keyframe animations or JavaScript-driven scroll-triggered effects to control the opacity and vertical position of individual elements, making them disappear or slide upwards at staggered intervals as the user scrolls down, creating a sense of depth and revealing the next content block.

Achieve the typographic contrast by pairing a custom, highly decorative serif font for large display headings with a modern, legible sans-serif for all other text. Adjust font sizes dramatically, with hero headings being several times larger than body text, and use uppercase for navigation and small labels to maintain a clean, structured feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, decorative serif headings (~5-6x body text) are juxtaposed with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, creating a distinct visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements featuring crisp corners; buttons have very subtle rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness and allowing typography to breathe.

standout: This site stands out with its bold and expressive use of typography, particularly the oversized, decorative serif headings that blend a vintage aesthetic with a modern, minimal layout. The playful inclusion of a smiley face and vintage TV graphic adds a distinctive, personal touch that elevates it beyond a generic portfolio.
